verification_scope: Reloaded and re-evaluated all 91 project checkpoints, including 24 new checkpoints; validation accuracy, parameters and MACs agree with recorded results. Actual frozen cascade routing reproduced 5721 correct. This verifies saved-model evaluation, not independent retraining or statistical significance.
question: Can hierarchical multi-scale MLP features, training-only auxiliary supervision or partial channel processing improve Fashion-MNIST classification?
scope: Dense MLPs only. Detector-inspired principles, not YOLO architecture or PGI reproduction. No outside dataset, convolution, attention, detection boxes or NMS.
data: Existing 54000/6000 stratified train/validation split; seed 58561440; normalization fitted on training only.
training_budget: 120 epochs per initial trial, same AdamW, warmup/cosine, augmentation and regularization. Ordinary/EMA/SWA checkpoints share one training trajectory. Clean refinement, if pursued, uses 30 epochs for all paired variants. Combined auxiliary+CSP is conditional on individual gains.
selection: Validation only. Compare new checkpoint single-model predictions and bounded additions/replacements in the frozen reference cascade. Maximize correct count, then reduce average MACs, parameters and NLL. Preserve correct count on both fixed validation halves and Shirt F1. Freeze before any final test evaluation.
limits: One seed and reused validation split; halves are development subsets, not independent holdouts. Public test has already been observed; no claim of blinded generalization or statistical significance.
monitoring: Per-epoch result JSON and process exit status. Each training command has a 30-minute hard timeout. Shared GPU processes are left untouched.
outcome: Reference retained at 5721/6000 correct. Best non-reference candidate: 5714/6000. No auxiliary-plus-CSP combination was added because auxiliary supervision did not improve its matched feature-fusion control.
anomalies: Initial CPU architecture self-check exposed a pre-existing device assumption in model_cost; fixed to use the model parameter device and reran successfully. All eight training runs exited successfully; no training retry or timeout.
